map.解读流式细胞术检测结果，评估PNH克隆大小及临床意义: Interprets flow cytometry results and assesses PNH clone size and clinical significance.
map.📖 查看「PNH 流式细胞术 (CD55/CD59) 检测器 使用指南」: 📖 Read the "PNH Flow Cytometry (CD55/CD59) Detector Usage Guide"
map.PNH 克隆大小 = CD55 或 CD59 缺失细胞比例，分别检测粒细胞与单核: PNH clone size = proportion of CD55- or CD59-deficient cells, measured separately for granulocytes and monocytes (monocytes more sensitive); clone at least 50% is large, 10-50% medium, below 10% small; a granulocyte clone above 20% with haemolysis suggests high risk, thrombosis risk rises with clone size, and LDH with D-dimer can be combined.
map.轻度或无溶血，AA/PNH综合征常见: Mild or no haemolysis, common in AA/PNH syndrome
map.典型PNH，溶血和血栓风险高: Classic PNH, high haemolysis and thrombosis risk
map.：LDH升高、结合珠蛋白降低、间接胆红素升高: : raised LDH, lowered haptoglobin, raised indirect bilirubin
map.：内脏/肝静脉/门静脉等不典型部位血栓: : thrombosis at atypical sites such as visceral / hepatic / portal veins
map.经典方法，可测红细胞: Classic method, can measure red cells
map.提示：PNH克隆检出需结合临床表现。AA/MDS患者检出小克隆属常见，不一定为经: Note: PNH clone detection must be combined with clinical presentation. A small clone in AA/MDS patients is common and not necessarily classic PNH. Complement inhibitors (e.g. eculizumab) suit PNH patients with haemolysis or thrombosis. For study reference only.
map.📚 深度解析：PNH 流式细胞术 (CD55/CD59) 检测器: 📚 Deep Dive: PNH Flow Cytometry (CD55/CD59) Detector
map.用 FLAER/粒细胞克隆大小评估 PNH 负荷（最可靠）: Use FLAER / granulocyte clone size to assess PNH burden (most reliable).
map.按克隆分级（亚临床<1 / 小 1–10 / 中 10–50 / 大>50）定治: Grade by clone size (subclinical <1 / small 1-10 / medium 10-50 / large >50) to set treatment indication.
map.结合血栓史、溶血、合并 AA 给警示: Combine thrombosis history, haemolysis and coexisting AA for warnings.
map.克隆分级：最大克隆（粒细胞系，FLAER 最灵敏）= I+II+III 型缺失细: Clone grading: largest clone (granulocyte line, FLAER most sensitive) = proportion of type I+II+III deficient cells. <1% subclinical, 1-10% small, 10-50% medium, >50% large. Red-cell clone is often underestimated by transfusion dilution, so the granulocyte line is the standard; large clones carry high thrombosis risk and need screening for visceral venous thrombosis.
map.例（粒细胞 CD59 缺失=30%、其余为 0、有溶血）：最大克隆=30% →: Example (granulocyte CD59 deficiency = 30%, others 0, with haemolysis): largest clone = 30% → medium clone (10-50%), haemolysis suggests monitoring LDH and iron metabolism; if clone >50% with haemolysis / thrombosis history, consider complement inhibitor (e.g. eculizumab).
map.FLAER 比 CD55/CD59 好在哪？: Where is FLAER better than CD55/CD59?
map.FLAER（荧光标记气单胞菌溶素）直接结合 GPI 锚，不受输血稀释、灵敏度高，: FLAER (fluorescently labelled aerolysin) binds the GPI anchor directly, is unaffected by transfusion dilution and highly sensitive, making it the gold standard for granulocyte PNH clones; traditional CD55/CD59 still helps but is easily affected by red-cell transfusion.
map.亚临床克隆要治疗吗？: Does a subclinical clone need treatment?
map.通常不需补体抑制，重点看是否合并再生障碍性贫血（AA/PNH 综合征），每 3–: Usually no complement inhibition; the focus is whether aplastic anaemia coexists (AA/PNH syndrome), and repeat flow cytometry every 3-6 months to monitor clone change.
